description: KiwiRail publishes a simplified national railway network with one polyline per named line. It includes existing track outside KiwiRail management but excludes proposed, historical and uplifted tracks. Track operational status is not included. The provider distinguishes this mapping product from its more detailed asset-level Track Centreline and excludes survey-accurate geometry, CAD design and elevation uses. Feature-service and WFS items are alternate access representations of the same simplified network. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
